shortDescription: Hungary's central bank left its base rate steady at 5.5% on Tuesday (HUINT=ECI), as expected, pausing a string of rate cuts amid increased global risks and a planned lowering of its inflation goal.The decision was in line with the median forecast in a Reuters poll last week.
